remarks: Wonderful Lake front contemporary providing for the ultimate in entertaining with spectacular views from the living room, kitchen and family room. The secluded property provides a private sanctuary for the ultimate in privacy. The primary suite has a full bath with tub and separate shower, two walk-in closets a cathedral ceiling and glass sliders to a private deck overlooking the vast lake.  The main level has two additional bedrooms. The lower level features an additional bedroom and office/family room with adjacent full bath. The laundry/utility room provides shelving for ample storage. The oversized 2-car garage accommodates two possibly three smaller cars and much storage. Don't miss this opportunity schedule a viewing today.
